fun_fact: Rap music has had a history of talking about issues like power, money or rebellion. So it's no surprise that climate has found its way to rap. Check out the first 2 songs of the Climate Emergency Mixtape: [Neer Kodu](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-2-7k_aTVkg&list=RD-2-7k_aTVkg&start_radio=1) and [Nisargacha Kaayda](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iRI_nHD2Zs4). They are lit!
